tasks.label: Menit.com audit tahap 1-4
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Mode,Length,LastWriteTime,Name; Write-Output '--- package files ---'; rg --files -g 'package.json' -g 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -g 'yarn.lock' -g 'package-lock.json' -g 'bun.lockb' -g '.env*' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'tsconfig.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' | Select-Object -First 200

tasks.label: Menit.com audit detail
tasks.command: Write-Output '--- runtimes ---'; node --version; npm --version; Write-Output '--- project files ---'; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Force -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\.git\\|\\node_modules\\' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length + 1) }; Write-Output '--- planning docs ---'; Get-ChildItem -File -Filter '*.md' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('### ' + $_.Name); Get-Content -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Raw }

tasks.label: Cek versi package Menit.com
tasks.command: npm.cmd view next version; npm.cmd view react version; npm.cmd view @supabase/supabase-js version; npm.cmd view @supabase/ssr version

tasks.label: Validasi build Menit.com
tasks.command: npm.cmd run build; Write-Output ('--- env files ---'); Get-ChildItem -Force -File -Filter '.env*' | Select-Object Name,Length; Write-Output ('--- source files ---'); Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File app,lib | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length + 1) }

tasks.label: Final check Menit.com tahap 1-4
tasks.command: npm.cmd run typecheck; Write-Output '--- files ---'; Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $_.FullName -notmatch '\\node_modules\\|\\.next\\' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName.Substring((Get-Location).Path.Length + 1) } | Sort-Object

tasks.label: Validasi UI Menit.com
tasks.command: npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd run build
